faqs.question: Does Indigenous manufacturing automatically make a cigarette tax-exempt?

faqs.question: Does a Main Kingston Cannabis menu listing prove who owns or manufactures a cigarette brand?

faqs.question: Are traditional tobacco and commercial cigarettes the same thing?
faqs.answer: No. Traditional or sacred tobacco practices are culturally distinct from modern commercial cigarettes.
